title: Emergency Response Learnings: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
audience: Emergency response, fire and control-room roles
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: The gas alarm showed on a display but started no shutdown, so the response depended on someone noticing it.

events.text: Gas detector alarms on the control-room display only
Response depends on the alarm being noticed; the export gives no times

items.lesson: A display-only gas alarm leaves detection to chance.
items.explanation: The DCS list shows no shutdown on the gas detector [EVD-0002].

rows: Say who acts on a display-only gas alarm, and how fast
The gas alarm shows on the display and starts no shutdown

items.text: Where the emergency plan is a regulated plan, a change to it may need review by, or notice to, an authority: the plan owner should check this before revising the plan.

items.situation: Inject: a gas alarm appears on the display during a shift handover.
prompts: Time standard: alarm to isolation decision

injects.text: The gas alarm shows on the display only; nothing trips.
The field operator does not answer the radio.
injects.decision: Isolate from the control room now, or send someone to look?
